  Questions about your own trading. Each was fixed as a written rule on a set
  date, and only trading after that date counts. Canary is filling the counts.
  This version does not work out the answers yet, and nothing here changes a
  verdict, a warning or an order.

    at last year's pace                                full about Jun 2028 *

  Do option buys made while premium at risk was at or below the budget line pay
  better than buys made above it?
    helps with buying                            option_buys_below_premium_line
    policy: the Rulebook's premium budget
    counts each contract once per week with a buy, when its position has closed
    at or below the line     ░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░    – of 30
    above the line                                       –
      Canary cannot sort these buys yet: this version does not work out premium
      at risk at the last statement. Until it does, no count can grow.
    no date for a full count
    a buy now: the premium budget line was 2.5% of net liquidation value at the
      20 Nov 2026 close, the Rulebook's line for calm markets

  Do single-name option buys made the session after a Regime warning do better

    counts each contract once per week with a buy, when its position has closed
    after a warning          ░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░    0 of 40
      on separate days       ░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░    0 of 20
    no date yet: Canary kept no Regime record before 21 Nov 2026, so there is
      no pace
    a buy now counts as after a warning: Regime was at early warning at the 20
      Nov 2026 close

  After you close an option position, is the contract worth more or less five
  sessions later?
    helps with holding or selling        final_option_sales_vs_close_5_sessions
    counts each closed single-name option position once
    sold above cost          ░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░    0 of 30
    sold below cost          ░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░    0 of 30
      full when either group reaches 30
    at last year's pace                                full about May 2027

  After a partial sale, would a floor at that sale's price have protected what
  was left?
    helps with selling                                 floor_after_partial_sale
    counts each single-name option position with a partial sale once, when it

    no date yet: you made no partial sale in the past year to set a pace

  After the underlying moved against you, is an option you sell worth more or

    helps with holding or selling               option_sales_after_adverse_move
    counts each name once per week with an option sale

    after a move in favour                               –
      Canary cannot sort these sales yet: this version does not work out the
      underlying's five-session move in expected moves. Until it does, no count
      can grow.
    no date for a full count
